notes: Ablation arms for the minute-feature predictor (plan 2026-10-09-data-windows.md, 'Feature families and selection'). `arms`: each is the list of KEPT families, passed as the `families` param of crypto_trading.minute_features:MinuteFeatures; a dropped family loses every column with its `<family>__` prefix and nothing else, so labels, `meta__scale` (the label divisor, in no family and not a model input) and the row set are identical in every arm. `scale_arms`: each is the list of KEPT scales (minutes), passed as the `scales` param; it drops that scale's columns from ret, trend, vol (rms, hl, jump) and the xasset pair change, and nothing else. The row set stays the same because `history_minutes` (default: the widest scale of the grid) fixes the warm-up, so leave it unset. Run `all`, then each `minus_*` arm, then each `minus_scale_*` arm on the same folds and seeds; keep a family or scale only if dropping it hurts beyond fold noise. The two ablations are separate runs: do not combine a family arm with a scale arm. `xasset` is the other asset's ret/vol columns plus the pair log ratio, a separate family from `ret`/`vol`. `holiday` needs the exchange_calendars library. `bvol` is an ablation family (26 missing days). tests/test_minute_features.py pins both lists to the node's declared FAMILIES and DEFAULT_SCALES, so a renamed or added family or scale fails there until this file follows.
